case_number: Criminal Appeal No. 942 of 2023; Criminal Appeal @ S.L.P. (Crl.) No.3400 of 2017
summary: Life sentence modification; Constitution Bench interpretation: modified life sentence permissible as death penalty alternative only; sessions courts powerless to impose fixed-term life sentences; gravity of offense, age, conduct, and remission considerations; Constitutional Courts' exclusive authority over sentence modification; death penalty not imposed in present case; no power to grant fixed-term life sentence.
legal_provisions_cited: Union of India v. V. Sriharan alias Murugan & Ors.
Swamy Shraddananda (2) v. State of Karnataka
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; life sentence for remainder of natural life confirmed.
